## {{< fa box-open title="an open box" >}} Required Packages {#pkgs}

We'll be using the following R packages: 

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true
#| code-line-numbers: false
library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactlog)
library(shinytest2)
library(diffviewer)
# library(chromote) # installed as a dependency of {shinytest2}, though there may be cases where you need to reinstall
```
